authority.note: PREREGISTERED only. Historical F-xxx and UNK-005 registration are not economic closure. economic_claims_allowed remains false until mt00==PASS and mt01_matrix_coverage==COMPLETE for this contract's pipeline_identity. No fusion weight, risk table, EngineRunner, DecisionEngine, or Ultron mutation is authorized by sealing this instance.

population.inclusion_rule: XAUUSD M15 OHLCV bars only; timestamps interpreted on declared clock_basis=UTC for session conditioning (F-066: research uses UTC-corrected labels; does not mutate production crt_engine.session_windows). Corpus path and SHA-256 locked at run into population fingerprint.
population.exclusion_rule: Bars with E_event=1 (scheduled high-impact release windows tagged at 12:30/13:30 UTC, e.g. NFP/CPI slots) excluded from CPR z-score baseline fitting (mu/sigma of CPR_Raw). Excluded bars may still appear in diagnostic counts but not in residual predictive tests. Holiday/gap policy: drop bars with missing prior bar > 1 M15 interval for rolling sums; document drop count in fingerprint.

features.point_in_time_rule: At decision bar t, all CPR rolling sums and z-score stats use bars with index <= t only (strict F_t). For targets defined on next-open execution, features may use bars <= t-1 only — declared per target at run. No centered swings, no global full-sample rank, no future volume. Residualization regressors F^(1..39) must be the same PIT feature frame as production v4.0 schema when residualizing against residualization_baseline.
builder_entrypoints: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_PREREG_ONLY — observe-only; builder lands only after E-MT-00 probe harness exists for this contract

labels.y_definition: Primary L1 targets (information only, not economic authority): (1) fwd_return_1b = (close_{t+1}-close_t)/close_t; (2) fwd_return_4b = (close_{t+4}-close_t)/close_t; (3) displacement_continuation = 1 if sign(close_t-open_t)==sign(close_{t+h}-close_t) for h in {4,16} else 0. Optional diagnostic morphology labels may be listed in the prereg doc but cannot promote economic claims. Economic R-multiple under forward_walk is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY under this contract until a superseding MC with label_family=forward_walk_economic and economic_admissible path is sealed.
labels.sign_convention: positive_fwd_return_is_up_move_in_price; not a trade long/short PnL

splits.embargo: 96 M15 bars (24h) between train end and test start
splits.purge: drop train labels whose horizon overlaps test start (max horizon 16 bars + embargo)
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: last 20% of eligible bars by UTC timestamp after event exclusion; exact dates locked in split_manifest at run

metrics.success_gate: L1 ONLY: on OOS, residual eta (after OLS residualization of cpr_raw or cpr_z on the 39-dim v4.0 feature vector) shows BH-FDR q<0.01 for pre-registered information tests (MI or Spearman IC vs fwd_return_1b/4b, or AUC vs displacement_continuation) AND residual R2 vs 39-dim baseline > 0 on OOS. Mutual information null is not required to be exactly 0.0000; use permutation null under seed 20260808. Economic E_OOS>0 is NOT a pass gate under this contract (info_not_value).
metrics.kill_criteria: KILL OHLCV-proxy claim if: (1) residual eta has no BH-significant association with any pre-registered target after multiplicity control; OR (2) residual R2 <= 0 vs 39-dim baseline (CPR is rename of existing features); OR (3) any required PIT/circularity probe fails (lookahead, same-bar outcome in F_t, event-baseline contamination). Do not reopen with N/cost tweaks — new thesis + new MC id required.
